title: The Listening House
author: Juniper Okonkwo
blurb: Xanthe Dunmore, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
